description: Functions and classes for SEL cable / hybrid bolt elements (sel hybrid create produces these).
note: 3DEC 7.0-only module: the legacy SEL (structural element) scripting interface. Absent from 3DEC 9.x, where structural elements are accessed through itasca.structure instead. All signatures and descriptions were captured from live 3DEC 7.00 (Release 161) __doc__ introspection.

functions.name: count
functions.description: Get the number of hybrid bolts.

functions.name: find
functions.description: Get the hybrid bolt object with the given ID number.

functions.name: maxid
functions.description: Get the maximum hybrid bolt ID.
